import functools
import leo.analysis.position_grid as _grid
_grid.sample_position_grid = functools.partial(
    _grid.sample_position_grid, maximum_seconds=300.0)
import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from leo.storage.fast_graph_position_v6 import FastGraphPositionStoreV6
from leo.storage.fast_standard_analysis import FastStandardAnalysisStore
import render_standard_fast as renderer
source_root,target_root,run_id=sys.argv[1:]
source_root=Path(source_root);target_root=Path(target_root)
marker=json.loads((source_root/'algo07-star-input.json').read_text())
assert marker['kind']=='algo07-star-native-evidence' and marker['run_id']==run_id
assert source_root!=Path(marker['source_root'])
target_root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
source=FastGraphPositionStoreV6(source_root);target=FastStandardAnalysisStore(target_root)
jobs=[j for j in source.completed_jobs() if j['run_id']==run_id]
assert len(jobs)==1
before=source.terminal(jobs[0])[1]
start=time.monotonic()
result=renderer.publish(source,target,jobs[0],evaluation_reference=renderer.evaluation_coordinates(37.849061591561885,-122.48574968092912))
wall=time.monotonic()-start
after=source.terminal(jobs[0])[1]
assert before==after and result['terminal_sha256']==after['sha256']
grid=target.position_grid(run_id)
print(json.dumps(dict(publication_wall_seconds=wall,grid_seconds=grid['elapsed_seconds'],grid_complete=grid['complete'],grid_evaluated=grid['evaluated_points'],grid_planned=grid['planned_points'],artifacts=len(result['artifacts']),source_terminal=after)),flush=True)
